Version: 2.1.3
Requires-Dist: typing-extensions>=4.6.0
Requires-Dist: greenlet>=1; extra == "asyncio"
Requires-Dist: mypy>=2.4; extra == "mypy"
Requires-Dist: types-greenlet>=2; extra == "mypy"
Requires-Dist: pyodbc; extra == "mssql"
Requires-Dist: pymssql; extra == "mssql-pymssql"
Requires-Dist: pyodbc; extra == "mssql-pyodbc"
Requires-Dist: mssql-python>=1.9.0; extra == "mssql-python"
Requires-Dist: mysqlclient>=1.4.0; extra == "mysql"
Requires-Dist: mysql-connector-python; extra == "mysql-connector"
Requires-Dist: mariadb!=1.1.10,!=1.1.2,!=1.1.5,>=1.0.1; extra == "mariadb-connector"
Requires-Dist: oracledb>=2.0.1; extra == "oracle"
Requires-Dist: cx_oracle>=8; extra == "oracle-cxoracle"
Requires-Dist: oracledb>=2.0.1; extra == "oracle-oracledb"
Requires-Dist: psycopg!=3.1.15,>=3.0.7; extra == "postgresql"
Requires-Dist: pg8000>=1.29.3; extra == "postgresql-pg8000"
Requires-Dist: sqlalchemy[asyncio]; extra == "postgresql-asyncpg"
Requires-Dist: asyncpg; extra == "postgresql-asyncpg"
Requires-Dist: psycopg2-binary; extra == "postgresql-psycopg2binary"

observation.command: cd /workspace && docker run --rm --entrypoint sh fristenmanagement:latest -c 'cat /app/.venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/sqlalchemy-*.dist-info/METADATA | grep -iE "^Requires-Dist|^Version" | head -20' 2>&1
